pending.why: Three lands that pay a real cost for an ability this deck cannot use. The 99 is mono-black identity with ZERO non-black pips, so 'add one mana of any color' is worth nothing here. City of Brass is the only pain land in the deck that buys nothing back — Ancient Tomb buys {C}{C} on turn one, Cabal Pit buys threshold removal, Ifnir Deadlands buys a Desert — and it taxes the resource Yawgmoth's engine spends, since 'Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature' is the deck's whole loop. Exotic Orchard makes its colour contingent on opponents' boards for a colour with 33 sources. Survivors' Encampment taps for {C} unless you tap a creature.

evidence.cabal_coffers: Coffers reads 'for each SWAMP you control'. Without Urborg on the battlefield it counts only basic Swamps, so 21 -> 24 is +3 mana per activation in every game Urborg has not shown up.
evidence.totals_unchanged: 36 lands, B33 sources, 87% on-curve, 2 taplands — measured before and after; the swap costs nothing measurable.
evidence.orphans_stack: none — no checker-passed stack scenario names any of the three (all 11 passing stacks checked)

notes: Held rather than applied because a decklist edit re-stamps decklist_sha256 and forces a ~690k regeneration; batching it with the next pass is cheaper than two.
The 11 passing stacks survive this swap untouched, so it is materially cheaper than the ur-dragon rebuild was.
